title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 9: the six men with slaughter weapons, the man in linen with the inkhorn and the mark on the forehead.

questions.text: What did the loud voice in his ears call for?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 9:1 says he cried with a loud voice for those in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.

answers.text: The elders of the city to gather at the gate
The people of the city to repent and to fast
Those in charge of the city, each with his destroying weapon
The priests to offer incense at the altar

questions.text: How many men came, and from which way?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 9:2 says six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand.

answers.text: Four men, from the way of the east gate
Seven men, from the way of the south gate
Twelve men, from the inner court of the house
Six men, from the upper gate toward the north

questions.text: What did the man in the middle of them wear and carry?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 9:2 says one man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer's inkhorn by his side.

answers.text: Clothed in linen, with a writer's inkhorn by his side
Clothed in sackcloth, with a trumpet
Clothed in armor, with a sword
Clothed in a priest's robe, with a censer

questions.text: Where did the men stand when they went in?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 9:2 says they went in and stood beside the bronze altar.

answers.text: At the threshold of the house
Beside the bronze altar
In the outer court
By the east gate

questions.text: From where did the glory of the God of Israel go up, and where did it go?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 9:3 says the glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub to the threshold of the house.

answers.text: From the altar to the mountain
From the east gate to the inner court
From the sky down to the plain
From the cherub to the threshold of the house

questions.text: What was the man clothed in linen told to do in the city?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 9:4 says he was to go through the middle of Jerusalem and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and cry over all the abominations done within it.

answers.text: Count all the houses of the city, one street at a time
Write down the names of all the elders of the city
Set a mark on the foreheads of those who sigh and cry over the abominations
Sprinkle blood on the doorposts of every house

questions.text: Where were the others told to begin?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 9:6 says they were to begin at my sanctuary, and then they began at the old men who were before the house.

answers.text: At the gate of the city
At the sanctuary
In the king's house
By the river outside the city

questions.text: What were they told to do to the house itself?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 9:7 says he told them to defile the house and fill the courts with the slain, and then go out.

answers.text: Defile it and fill the courts with the slain
Shut its doors and seal them up
Burn it with fire to the ground
Leave it untouched and go out

questions.text: What did he do while they were killing and he was left?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 9:8 says he fell on his face and cried, "Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?"

answers.text: He ran out of the city and hid himself away
He stood up and praised God with a loud voice
He fell on his face and cried out for the residue of Israel
He said nothing at all and went out quietly

questions.text: What did the man clothed in linen report at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 9:11 says the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported, "I have done as you have commanded me."

answers.text: "The city is full of violence"
"I have done as you have commanded me"
"No one was found with the mark"
"I could not find the door"
